events.title: Open Source Initiative founded
events.summary: Eric Raymond and Bruce Perens co-founded the Open Source Initiative in February 1998 — coining 'open source' as a business-friendly term.
events.about: OSI certified licenses and promoted open source to enterprises skeptical of Stallman's '[free software]' framing. The term enabled [Netscape]'s Mozilla release and the dot-com open-source wave.

narrative.whyChosen: OSI rebranded [free software] for corporate adoption.
narrative.whyImportant: It separated pragmatic open collaboration from ideological [free software] debates.
narrative.problemSolved: Businesses avoided '[free software]' language that sounded anti-commercial.
